tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// dpal kye rdo rje'i mngon rtogs yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ dpal kye rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// stong nyid snying rje ro gcig bcom ldan 'das// srid gsum sgrol mdzad kye yi rdo rje dpal// de thob bya phyir de la phyag 'tshal nas// de yi sgrub pa'i rim pa bdag gis bshad// de la dpal kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i kye rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i tshul la gnyis te/ mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po la gnyis/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ rgyu tshogs gnyis bsag pa dang*/ 'bras bu lhar bskyed pa'o// dang po la gnyis las/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa ni/ stan bde ba la ci bder bar 'dug nas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la snying thag pa nas skyabs su song la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i phyir kye rdo rje bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgoms nas/ skad cig gis rang kye'i rdo rjer mos pa'i snying gi nang du/ padma la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sems 'od gsal bar bsams pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ sngon po gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i yid du lhag par mos la/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi sdig pa sbyangs/ sna'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbur brgyan pa spyan drangs la/ yid kyis phyag 'tshal nas/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis mchod par bya ste/ gau rī nag mo thig le 'dzin pas mchod/ tsau rī dmar mos rakta/ be tā lī ser mos dri chu/ ghasma rī ljang gus dri chen/

pukka sī sngon mos sha chen 'dzin pas mchod pa ni nang gi'o// sha wa rī dkar mos grub pa'i dngul chu 'dzin pa/ tsaṇḍa lī sngon mos ḍā ma ru'i sgras mchod pa ni phyi'i'o// ḍombi nī kha dog sna tshogs pas bde ba chen pos mchod pa de kho na nyid kyi'o// de ltar mchod nas sngar byas pa'i sdig pa la 'gyod pa dang*/ phyin chad bsdam pa'i bsam pa drag pos bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe thog ma med pa nas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las ci bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba de dag bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi spyan sngar so sor bshags shing*/ yang mi bgyid do zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas gzhan gyi dge ba ma lus pa la dga' zhing yi rang ba'i bsam pas/ so so skye bo dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang bar bgyi'o// zhes brjod do// de ltar bsags pa'i dge ba mchog gi dngos grub tu bsngo ba'i bsam pas/ bdag gis de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub snying po kye rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod do// de nas bla ma dang gtso bo sangs rgyas/ lam rim pa gnyis yan lag dang bcas pa chos/ 'khor gyi lha mo dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dge 'dun du shes par byas la/ de rnams la snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro ba'i bsam pas bdag dus 'di nas bzung ste snying po kye rdo rje'i go 'phang la mchis kyi bar du thun mong ma yin pa'i yul dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas mchod pa'i yul dang bdag nyid dang mchod pa rnams rang bzhin gyis ma grub cing*/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa la de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la rab tu brtse ba'i snying rje bskyed nas/

de rnams kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i phyir/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed snyam du bsams la/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa'i byams pa/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i snying rje/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i dga' ba/ sems can thams cad dgra dang gnyen med pa'i btang snyoms te tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas chos thams cad stong par bsam pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// gnyis pa 'bras bu lhar bskyed pa la gnyis/ sngon du 'gro ba srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang*/ dngos gzhi lha'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po ni stong pa'i ngang las/ pam̐ las padma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang gu/ rdo rje'i rwa thams cad rtse mo gsum pa/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsam/ de las 'od zer phyogs kun tu 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ phyi rol kun tu ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab bo// thun mong ma yin pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'ang skabs 'dir bsgom te gzhan du shes par bya'o// srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'o// de nas dngos gzhi lha'i rnal 'byor la gnyis las/

rten bskyed pa'i phyir srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ gzhi'i yan lag e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ gdengs kha gyen du bstan pa/ de'i nang du rgyu'i yan lag lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po// de'i steng du bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po/ de'i steng du yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu bdungs pa lta bu ljang sngon rnams so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa bsgoms nas/ rkyen gyi yan lag rang gi sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin/ dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang gu nag po ste rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i mda' yab dang pu shu yod pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu la lha mo bcu drug gi mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres shing*/ mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje phyed pa'i tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo'i thad so bzhir ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang*/ ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang*/ 'phan dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang pa bsgom/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar du gtum drag gi dur khrod/ lhor 'jigs byed thod pa can/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ byang shar du drag du dgod pa/

shar lhor dbang phyug nags tshal/ lho nub tu mun pa mi bzad pa/ nub byang du ki li ki la'i sgra sgrogs pa ste/ dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag gi nang na phyogs skyong brgyad gnas te/ shar du brgya byin ser po glang po che la zhon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa dbyug to 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa phyag bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang dbyu gu rtse gsum pa/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis bgrang phreng dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po nag po ro langs la zhon pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rlung lha ljang sngon sha ba la zhon pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rgyan gyis brgyan zhing rang dang 'dra ba'i rig mas g.yon nas brten pa la lag pa g.yon pas 'khyud cing*/ spyi bos bcom ldan 'das la 'dud pa'o// rim pa de nyid kyis shing chen po brgyad gnas te/ shi ri sha tsu ta/ kaṃ ka la/ a shwa dha/ shing chen po/ ka rañdza/ 'khril shing can/ ardzu na rnams so// shing de rnams la brten pa'i zhing skyong brgyad ni/ rim pa bzhin lha'i dge 'dun dkar po/ gshin rje sngon po/ sprin gyi rgyal po dmar po/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon ser po/ yi dwags 'dus pa dud kha/ drang srong 'dus pa dmar po/ sprin gyi tshogs can nag po/ rlung gi rgyal po ljang gu ste thams cad shing lo'i nang nas lus phyed thon pa/ phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi bzhon pa'i mgo brnyan can gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o// klu chen po brgyad ni rim pa bzhin nor rgyas ser po/ padma dkar po/ karko ṭa nag po/ 'jog po dmar po/ padma chen po dkar po/ hu lunta sngon po/

rigs ldan ljang gu/ dung skyong ser po rnams sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan zhing sbrul 'jug 'khyil pa/ stod lha'i lus can thal mo sbyar ba'o// sprin chen po brgyad ni/ rim pa bzhin sgrogs byed/ ldog byed/ 'jigs byed/ 'khor byed/ mthug po/ 'gengs byed/ char 'bebs/ gtum po rnams te nam mkha' la gnas pa/ phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi kha dog dang mthun pa'o// gzhan yang mchod rten chen po brgyad/ chu bo brgyad/ me brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gang ba/ ro dang*/ ro langs dang*/ 'dre dang*/ srin po dang*/ sha za'i tshogs dang bcas pa bsam mo// gzhal yas khang pa'i nang du padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ nyon mongs pa la sogs pa bdud bzhi'i ngo bo tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nye dbang sngon po/ byang du drag po nag po/ byang shar du gshin rje sngon po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/ lho nub tu srin po nag po/ nub byang du thag zangs ris dud kha rnams ni/ 'gyel zhing gdong steng du phyogs pa'i gdan bsam mo// gnyis pa brtan pa lha bskyed pa la bzhi las/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag ni/ gdan dgu po re'i steng du mu tig gi phreng ba lta bu'i/ a ā/ i ī u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ zhes pa phrag gnyis gnyis bsgom/ de mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis su bsam/ de zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dgur gyur/ de sangs rgyas kyi me long lta bu'i ye shes su bsam/ de rnams kyi steng du byu ru'i phreng ba lta bu'i/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ zhes pa phrag gnyis gnyis bsgom/

de sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cur bsgom/ de zhu ba las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dgur gyur/ de sangs rgyas kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su bsam/ dbus kyi nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bar du hūm̐ las thod pa dkar po sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ aṃ las gri gug sngo nag yu ba la aṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ de sangs rgyas kyi so sor rtog pa'i ye shes su bsgom/ steng gi nyi ma/ 'og gi zla ba/ bar gyi phyag mtshan rnams gcig tu 'dres par bsgom/ de sangs rgyas kyi bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes su bsam/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dgyes pa'i rdo rje sku mdog sngon po/ zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngo/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ rgyab kyi zhal bzhi gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po/ de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang dmar po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal ka drug pa na mi dmar pobadun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang sngon/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor sbyin ser po 'dzin pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas brgyan zhing*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa/ rgyab ma gnyis gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/

g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga cu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam/ de sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so// de nas yum gyi mkha' padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ ze 'bru la āḥs mtshan par bskyed la/ oṃ padma su khā dhā ra/ ma hā rā ga su khandha da/ tsa tu rā nanda bha ga bi shwa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kāryaṃ ku ru ṣa me/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ rang gi gsang gnas rdo rje sngon po rtse mo lnga pa/ lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan par bskyed la/ oṃ badzra ma hā de ṣa/ tsa tu rā nanda dā ya kaḥ kha ga mu kha e kā ra so nā tha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kāryaṃ ku ru ṣwa me/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas yab yum gnyis snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chen po'i sgra ha ha si si kundu ru badzra dhṛ ka ces pa'i sgra grag pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ rang gi zhal du zhugs/ snying gar zhu/ yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas nas babs pas/ yum gyi mkhar thig le brgyad du gyur/ de rnams nyi zla kha sbyor brgyad kyi bar du spros/ thig le de rnams las/ shar du gaṃ las gri gug yu bar gaṃ gis mtshan pa/ lhor tsaṃ las ḍā ma ru rked par tsaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ nub du bam̐ las rus sbal dpral bar bam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ byang du ghaṃ las sbrul dpral bar ghaṃ gis mtshan pa/ byang shar du pam̐ las seng ge dpral bar pam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ shar lhor shaṃ las dge slong thugs kar sham̐ gis mtshan pa/ lho nub tu lam̐ las 'khor lo lte bar laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ nub byang du ḍaṃ las rdo rje lte bar ḍaṃ gis mtshan par gyur nas/ nyi zla phyag mtshan dang bcas pa rnams so so'i gnas su 'dres pa las lha mo brgyad bskyed de/ shar du gau rī nag mo phyag g.yas gri gug

g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor tsau rī dmar mo g.yas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon phag pa/ nub tu be tā lī ser mo g.yas rus sbal/ g.yon thod pa/ byang du ghasma rī ljang gu g.yas sbrul/ g.yon thad pa/ byang shar du pukka sī sngon mo g.yas seng ge g.yon dgra st+wa/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong*/ g.yon 'khar gsil/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thod gshol/ nub byang du g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa phyag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdig mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhabs g.yon pa brkyang pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam mo// de nas yab yum gnyis snyoms par zhugs pas rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu nas/ bdud bzhi'i steng du bde ba chen po'i ngo bo byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le gcig tu gyur par bsam/ de las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa'i don du/ mtshams kyi lha mo bzhis glus bskul ba ni/ pukka sīs byams pa tshad med pa'i sgo nas glus bskul ba/ rje btsun snying rjes yid bzhengs shig /pukka sī ni bdag la skyobs// stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la// bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod// de nas ri khrod mas snying rje tshad med pa'i sgo nas glus bskul ba/ khyod med na ni bdag 'gums pas// kye yi rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la// ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod// de nas tsaṇḍā līs dga' ba tshad med pa'i sgo nas glus bskul ba/ dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer ba// stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci// khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas// gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid// de nas ḍam̐ bi nīs btang snyoms tshad med pa'i sgo nas glus bskul ba/

g.yung mo bdag ni sgrin pas na// bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyis// snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad par// mig 'phrul lta bur khyod bzhengs shig /ces glus bskul bas thig le de dum bu gsum du gyur/ 'og gi ā li las zla ba/ steng gi kā li las nyi ma/ bar gyi thig le sa bon las phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de rnams 'dres gcig tu gyur pa las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs te/ de'ang kye'i rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa sngar bzhin du bskyed cing gsal gdab bo// de nas lha rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i gtso bo'i thugs kar hūm̐/ bdag med ma'i thugs kar aṃ/ lha mo rnams kyi thugs kar rim pa bzhin/ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ rnams bsam/ de rnams las 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros nas snod kyi 'jig rten gyi khams la phog snod thams cad gzhal yas khang par gyur/ yang 'od zer spros pas sems can rnams la phog sems can rnams kye'i rdo rje lha dgur gyur nas/ gzhal yas khang pa rnams kyi nang na gnas par bsam/ 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus pas rang rang la thim par bsgom mo// gnyis pa skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag ni/ rang gi bsgoms pa'i lha rnams kyi mig tu maṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar daṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar paṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ khar raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar aṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ snying gar naṃ las bdag med rdo rje ma nag mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje dmar mo/ snying gar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje nag mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ gri gug dang*/ thod pa dang*/ kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gdan ro mnan pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/

rgyan dang cha lugs lha mo rnams dang 'dra bar bsam mo// gsum pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug sgrub pa'i yan lag ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor rang gi bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i gau rī la sogs pa rnams kyis sngar bzhin mchod la/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis mchog brnyes te// khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa// sgyu ma'i spros pas rdo rje bsgrubs pa'i yid// he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes// zhes pas bstod nas/ rang gi snying ga nas gau rī lcags kyu 'dzin pa mang po spros la/ ye shes pa rnams kyi thugs kar lcags kyus reg nas nye bar bkug par bsam/ lus kyis lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bya/ ngag tu oṃ e hye hi bha ga wāṃ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes 'og ma gsum la'ang sbyar ro// gau rī ā karṣa ya dzaḥzhes brjod pas/ ye shes pa rnams rang la nye bar byon/ de nas tsau rī dmar mo zhags pa 'dzin pa mang po spros/ zhags pas ye shes pa rnams kyi mgrin par reg nas nye bar bkug par bsam zhing*/ zhags pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ tsau rī pra be sha ya hūm̐ zhes brjod pas gzhal yas khang gi nang du byon/ de nas be tā lī ser mo lcags sgrog thogs pa mang po spros/ ye shes pa rnams kyi zhabs la reg nas bdag la thim par bsam zhing*/ lcags sgrog gi phyag rgya byas la/ be tā lī bandha baṃ zhes brjod pas rang la thim/ de nas ghasma rī dril bu 'dzin pa mang po spros/ dril bu'i sgras thams cad la khyab par bsam zhing*/ dril bu'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ bha ga wāṃ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wā ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥzhes brjod pas ye shes pa rnams rang la mnyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsam mo// bzhi pa dbang bskur nas rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag ni/

yang rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ mi bskyod pa/ rnam par snang mdzad/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa ste rigs lnga/ spyan ma/ mā ma kī gos dkar mo/ sgrol ma ste yum bzhi/ byams pa/ sa'i snying po/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ kun tu bzang po/ phyag na rdo rje/ spyan ras gzigs/ nam mkha'i snying po/ 'jam dbyangs te byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ gshin rje gshed/ shes rab mthar byed/ padma mthar byed/ bgegs mthar byed/ mi g.yo ba/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ dbyug sngon can/ stobs po che/ gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ gnod mdzes te khro bo bcu/ gzugs rdo rje/ sgra rdo rje/ dri rdo rje/ ro rdo rje/ reg rdo rje/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje ma ste lha mo drug spyan drangs/ gau rī la sogs pas sngar bzhin du mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rje bdag la gsol// 'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs// yid dang phrag dog chen po kun// rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mgon// las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa// rdo rje can kun bdag dgyes mdzod// ces pas bstod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi// khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol// zhes pa dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsantu māṃ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lngas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsung gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing*/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rig mas rdo rje'i glu blangs/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bos bgegs bskrad/ lha mo drug gis mchod nas dbang bskur/

dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa// rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med// mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /lag pa rnam par snang mdzad brjod// ska rags la ni don yod gnas// yan lag kun la rdo rje 'dzin// zhes rgyan drug gi dag pa dran par bya/ dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun des mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo las kyi phyag rgya/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo chos kyi phyag rgya/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo phyag rgya chen po zhes/ 'khor lo bzhi'i dag pa dran par bya/ dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun des/ snying ga yan chad gang*/ yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs pa skye mched kyi dag pa dran par bya/ dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun des rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis/ gau rī dang pukka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang sha ba rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ be tā lī dang tsaṇḍā lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma rī dang ḍoṃ bi nī la 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas lha dang dkyil 'khor rnams snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ja' tshon dang 'dra ba la/ dmigs pa gtad la yid mnyam par gzhag go /gzugs kyi sku mngon du byed pa'i lam bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// //de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ lus skyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam gzhag sgal tshigs drang por bsrangs te/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor dang ldan pas phyi nang gi rnam g.yeng spangs nas/ rang gi lus kyi dbus kyi cha la spyi gtsug nas lte ba'i bar du rtsa a wa dhū tī shin tu phra zhing gsal ba thig le'i dwangs mas gang ba/

de'i g.yas su ro ma/ me'i rang bzhin raktas gang ba dmar po/ g.yon du rkyang ma chu'i rang bzhin byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba dkar po ste rtsa gsum gsal gdab/ de nas a wa dhū tī la brten pa'i lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo/ rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte bar a dmar po me'i rang bzhin mgo gyen la lta ba/ nang skor gyi 'dab ma brgyad la/ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha phyi'i 'dab ma la ā li phrag gnyis/ kā li phrag gcig la ha dang kṣa spangs pa/ snying gar chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte bar/ hūm̐ nag po mgo thur du lta ba/ phyogs bzhir bhrūm̐ āṃ dzrīṃ kham̐/ mtshams bzhir laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ/ mgrin par longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i lte bar oṃ dmar po mgo gyen du lta ba/ 'dab ma la ā li phrag gcig spyi bor bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo/ rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar haṃ dkar po mgo thur la lta ba/ 'dab ma la ā li phrag gnyis bsam/ de ltar rtsa dang 'khor lo rnams gsal btab nas/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzums kyi sbyor ba byas pas/ 'og gi rlung gis lte ba'i gtum mo'i me sbar nas/ g.yas ro ma'i me dang 'grogs te gyen du cher 'bar/ snying ga dang mgrin pa'i 'khor lo bsregs/ spyi bo'i haṃ la mes reg pas/ haṃ las byang sems thig le'i rgyun g.yon rkyang ma'i byang chub kyi sems dang bsdongs nas rim gyis babs pas/ mgrin pa dang snying ga'i 'khor lo rnams sngar bas kyang gsal bar gsos btab nas/ thigs pa gcig lte ba'i a la phog pas a las me'i zer shin tu phra ba rtsa a wa dhū tī'i nang nas myur du song nas/ snying ga'i hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i aṃ bcom/ spyi bo'i haṃ la phog pas/ haṃ las byang sems dwangs ma shin tu phra ba'i rgyun dbu ma'i lam nas 'dzag snying ga'i hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i aṃ gsal btab nas/ de'i nus pas lte ba'i me cher 'bar/ 'bar ba dang 'dzag pa dbu mar thim pas/

'bar ba'i nus pas lus drod kyis gang zhing*/ nad dang rtog pa bsregs/ 'dzag pa'i stobs kyis rtsa sbubs thams cad thig les khengs nas bde bas lus rgyas/ sems la ye shes skyes par bsam zhing*/ rlung kha sbyar bsgom par bya'o// rgyun du bsgoms na drod 'bar zhing*/ gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin skye la/ goms na rang byung gi ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro// ye shes des lha dang phyi rol gyi dngos po rnams la rgyas btab nas bsgoms pas/ bskyed rim gyi mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i dug sbyangs nas/ zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur zhing*/ chos sku mngon du byed pa'i lam yin no// rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i tshul mang du gsungs pa las/ rang byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa shin tu zab pa 'di yin no// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo las dang po pas bsgom pa dka' ba'i phyir 'dir ma bris so// rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// tha mal pa dang rang rtog pa// rim pa gnyis kyis rab sbyangs nas// zung 'jug ye shes lam gyis ni// sku gnyis mngon du byed par 'gyur// zhes shes par bya'o// mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro// //don gnyis pa mnyam gzhag las langs nas mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la brgyad/ nyal ba/ ldang ba/ khrus/ bzlas pa/ mchod gtor/ kha zas/ spyod lam/ rjes su chags pa'i rnal 'byor ro// de la nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ srod kyi bya ba rnams yongs su tshar nas gnyid log khar byed la/ de'ang lugs gnyis las/ rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa stong pa'i ngang la nyal ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od spros nas khams gsum snod bcud srung ba'i 'khor lo la bsdu/ srung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod la/ de gzhal yas khang la/ de lha mo brgyad la/ lha mo rnams rang rang gi thad ka'i zhal rnams la bsdu ste/ be tā lī ni steng zhal la'o// yum yab la/ yab hūm̐ la bsdu/ hūm̐ nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar mi dmigs par gyur nas/

stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal lo// gnyis pa zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa bde ba'i ngang la nyal ba ni/ gzhal yas khang mi bsdu la/ 'khor rnams zhal rnams la bsdus nas/ yab yum gnyis snyoms par zhugs pas/ bde ba chen po'i mes yab yum gnyis zhu nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi thig ler gyur par bsams la/ bde ba'i ngang la nyal ba'o// phan yon gnyis te/ tha mal gyi gnyid kyis mi rdzi ba dang*/ 'chi ba sbyong bar byed pa'o// ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni tho rangs gnyid sad pa'i tshe byed la/ de'ang lugs gnyis las/ stong pa'i ngang las ldang ba ni/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ rang gi shes pa 'od gsal ba las kye'i rdo rje'i skur langs/ de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od spro zhing hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa snod bcud dang bcas pa dmigs nas/ rang gzugs kyi sku snod bcud rnams phrin las la 'jug pa'i yul du bsams la ldang ngo*// gnyis pa/ bde ba'i ngang las ldang ba ni/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo bzhi byon nas glus bskul bas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa'i tshul gyis langs la/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od spros pas lha mo rnams dang snod bcud kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par gsal bar blta'o// phan yon gnyis te/ tha mal g.yeng ba mi rdzi zhing skye ba sbyong bar byed pa'o// khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ mchod pa lngas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag gi dri ma rnam par sbyang du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ ye shes kyi chus bdag gi spyi bo nas blugs pas/ phyi nang gi dri ma dag par bsam zhing*/ rang gis yi ge brgya pa brjod/ mthar dri ma thams cad dag cing ye shes kyi chus gang bar bsam zhing lha rnams gshegs su gsol/

phan yon la gnyis te/ ting nge 'dzin gyi grogs su 'gyur ba dang*/ yan lag gi ltung ba dang sdig pa 'dag pa'o// de nas snga dro'i thun mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni gong du brjod zin la/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni lha rnams gsal bar dmigs nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba 'od kyi rnam par 'phros/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i aṃ la thim/ mkha' nas 'thon/ yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ de ltar 'khor zhing de las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bskul bar bsams nas/ rang gi sngags brjod pa'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyis kyang mgrin gcig tu brjod par bsam mo// 'khor rnams kyis ni rang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon la 'khor bar bsam zhing bzla'o// sngags kyi kha dog ni/ zhi ba la dkar po/ rgyas pa la ser po/ dbang la dmar po/ drag po la nag po/ sngags kyi tshig ni 'di rnams yin no// oṃ aṣṭā na nā ya/ piṃ gordha ke sha warta ma ne/ tsa tur bi sha ti ne trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣṇa dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā lā ne kā dhā ri ṇe/ adhmū ta krū ra tsittā ya/ ardhendu daṃṣṭī ṇe/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardzadza ya gardzadza ya/ tardzadza ya tardzadza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sapta sā ga rā ṇa/ bandha bandha/ nā gāṣṭa kān/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa sha trūṃ/ ha hā/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hai/ ho hau/ haṃ haḥphaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ni rtsa ba'i sngags so// oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o// oṃ badzra karta ri he badzrā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o// oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yum gyi'o// oṃ āḥgaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥtsaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥghaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

oṃ āḥpaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥshaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥlaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥḍaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'khor gyi lha mo rnams kyi sngags so// tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chad par bzla'o// gtso bo'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyi bsnyen pa ni 'bum phrag brgyad/ snying po 'bum phrag bcu gsum/ nye snying 'bum phrag bcu drug go /lha mo rnams kyi ni khri phrag brgyad brgyad do// de tsam gyis ni dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba la sogs par 'jug par dbang ngo*// byang chub sgrub pa la ni tshad med do// phan yon gnyis te/ thun mong gi dngos grub tshegs med par 'grub pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes 'jug pa'o// mchod pa dang gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ dben pa'i gnas su maṇḍal khru gang gi tshad dang ldan par byas nas/ ba byung lnga dang dri bzang gis byug de'i mdun du chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ chang la bdud rtsi'i ri lu sbyang ba'i nang mchod dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu bzhag nas/ nang mchod kyis yo byad rnams la gtor shing*/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod la bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmā swā bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod la stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas rnams hūm̐ las lha rdzas las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che bar bskyed nas/ so so'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlab/ de nas maṇḍal gyi dbus su dri'i chu blugs nas lag pa g.yas pas g.yas skor du byug cing*/ der srung ba'i 'khor lo rang gis bsgoms pa bzhin skad cig gis bskyed/ de nas lha'i gnas dgur dri'i thig le byas nas me tog tshom bu bkod la/ srung 'khor gyi nang du dur khrod brgyad dang*/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa'i rten dang*/ me tog gi tshom bu rnams brten pa lha dgur skad cig gis bskyed nas rim gyis gsal btab la/

skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab bo// de nas rang gi lag pa g.yas pa hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ g.yon pa a las padma 'dab ma lnga pa as mtshan par bskyed la/ hūm̐ a zhes brjod pas/ de dag zhu ba las byung ba'i lag par byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ g.yas pas rdo rje blangs te smin mtshams kyi bar du lan gsum gsor la/ hūm̐ zhes brjod la snying gar bzung nas/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems thugs kyi dam tshig du dran par bya/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe aḥzhes brjod cing g.yon pas dril bu blangs te dkrol nas/ kha gyen du bstan te dkur bzung la/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa ston par byed pa gsung gi dam tshig tu dran par bya/ de nas rang he ru kar dmigs pa phyag rgya'i dam tshig tu dran par bya ste/ dam tshig gsum gyis rang byin gyis brlabs nas/ dril bu gnas brgyad du dkrol zhing*/ de'i sgras nam mkha'i mthas klas par khyab pas bla ma rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang*/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad bskul nas spyan drang bar bsam zhing ngag tu/ oṃ badzra dharma ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsā li ta/ pra dzñā pā ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha be ta/ badzra dharma hṛ da ya ni santo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ a khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ e hye hi bha ga wān/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa la mchod cing bstod nas/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la bstim pa dang*/ dbang bskur nas rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa rang gis bsgoms pa ltar byas la gtso bo dang bla ma tha mi dad par bsam mo// mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'o// de nas thog mar phyi'i mchod pa ni/ so so'i phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas/

dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa mchod pa'i sngags kun gyi thog mar sbyar la/ ni ri hūm̐ khaṃ zhes pas zhabs bsil dbul/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil gyi gnas su zhal bsil dang*/ ne bi te āḥhūm̐ gis zhal bsil dang*/ zhal bsil gyi gnas su 'thor 'thung dang*/ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hās 'thor 'thung*/ 'thor 'thung gi gnas su mchod yon dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥm hā arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dbul lo// de bzhin du/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa// bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog tshal dag ro ni phan pa dang*// gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed la// dge zhing mun pa rnams sel ba// bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ 'di ni dri bzang dge ba ste// dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa// bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes pa ma mdzod// oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri chab/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yi gar 'ong*// sngags kyi zhal zas bshos 'di dag /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ badzra nai bi dhye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ badzra dharma ra ṇi zhes pa nas a khaṃ swā hā'i bar gong du bstan pa ltar brjod la rol mo dbul lo// phyi'i mchod pa'o// de nas nang gi mchod pa gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/

g.yon pa'i mthe bong dang srin lag gis gtor/ sems kyis thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba du mas mchod par bsam zhing*/ thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ de nas bla ma brgyud pa la so so'i mtshan gyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams dang yi dam rnams la so so'i sngags kyis dbul/ de nas rang gi lce/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su reg la lus kyi lha rnams mchod/ de nas chos skyong srung ma dang*/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams la dbul/ mthar rigs drug gi sems can rnams la'ang byin pas tshim par bsam mo// nang gi mchod pa'o// de nas yid las byung ba'i gau rī la sogs pa'i mchod pas gong bzhin du mchod par bsam zhing*/ nam mkhar rje btsun bltas nas ni// rdo rje skye ba snying rje che// rgyan rnams thams cad 'dzin pa yi// lha mo brgyad po rnams kyis mchod// dkor mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// pukka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u rdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces brjod do// de nas bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ rang gi lus dpag tu med par sprul pa dang*/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu bstod par bsams la/ dngos su phyag 'tshal ba'am/ yang na yid kyis phyag 'tshal bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bla mar mos pa la thog mar bstod pa bya ste/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// ces pa dang gzhan yang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// zhes pa la sogs pas bstod do// de nas dkyil 'khor la bstod pa'i bsam pas/

khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /ces pa la sogs pa ci shes pas bstod do// de nas sdig pa dang nyes ltung rnams sbyang zhing tshogs 'dums par bya ba'i don du tsog pur 'dug nas/ thal mo sbyar la don dran par bya zhing*/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgrin du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'od spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum brjod do// byang chub kyi sems dang dam tshig dang sdom pa brtan par gzung ba'i phyir/ ji skad brjod par 'gyur ba'i don dran par bya zhing*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re zhing ni dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// padma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog

/dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum brjod pas/ dam tshig dang sdom pa blangs nas/ las bsags pa 'bras bu dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// smyo med kye yi rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rje ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /ces lan gsum du smon lam gdab bo// de'i rjes su gtor ma gtang bar bya ste/ gtor ma sha la sogs pas brgyan la chang dang chu la sogs pas sbyangs/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du āḥlas thod pa dkar po rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du shar du go las ba lang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha de rnams kyi steng du shar du bhrūm̐ las dri chen/ lhor ā las rakta/ nub tu dzrīṃ las byang chub kyi sems/ byang du khaṃ las klad pa/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bhrūm̐ las me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor āṃ las mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dzrīṃ las so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ las bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ las chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po mgo thur la lta ba'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

zla ba'i steng du g.yon skor du ā li/ g.yas skor du kā lis bskor bar bsam/ de nas rdo rje'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos pas me sbar nas/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga dang bcas pa zhu/ rlangs pa oṃ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag hūm̐ la phog de las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas bkug rdo rje la thim pas rdo rje nyi ma dang oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung nas rdzas thams cad zhu ste/ kha dog dang*/ ro dang*/ dri dang nus pa phun sum tshogs par bskyed la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa dang ha ho hrīḥzhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i nang du/ padma 'dab ma brgyad pa sum brtsegs kyi dbus ma'i lte bar kye rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ steng gi padma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la oṃ/ bar gyi 'dab ma brgyad la hūm̐/ 'og gi padma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la āḥbasam/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las steng gi dbus su sku rdo rje dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ padma'i shar du dbang phyug chen po/ lhor lha'i dbang po/ nub tu tshangs pa/ byang du khyab 'jug byang shar du bhṛṅki ri ti/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i dbang phyug lho nub tu tshogs kyi bdag po/ nub byang du gzhon nu kārti kā/ de dag thams cad kyang kha dog dang phyag mtshan yum dang bcas pa gtso bo dang 'dra/ dbus kyi padma'i 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ byang shar du dbang ldan/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ de dag thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

mdog sngon po/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i rig ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud par bsam/ 'og gi padma'i lte ba la gsung rdo rje sku mdog dmar po// zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang gnyis su med pa/ 'dab ma la shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor dung skyong*/ nub tu mtha' yas/ byang du nor rgyas/ shar lhor 'jog po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du padma/ byang shar du padma chen po'o// de dag thams cad sku mdog dang phyag mtshan yum dang bcas pa gsung rdo rje dang 'dra'o// thams cad kyang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bsam mo// de nas sku rdo rje'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ nam mkha' la gnas pa'i lha la sogs pa thams cad lha chen po brgyad la bsdu/ kyai rdo rje'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sa'i steng gi sems can thams cad phyogs skyong brgyad la bsdu/ gsung rdo rje'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ sa 'og gi sems can thams cad klu chen po brgyad la bsdu/ de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs pa skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ de nas rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ arghaṃ pā dyaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ gau rī ā karṣa ya dzaḥzhes pa la sogs pas mdun bskyed la bstim/ yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas rigs lnga spyan drangs la mchod nas/ khyed kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lngas dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas sku rdo rje lha chen po brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ kye rdo rje phyogs skyong brgyad dang bcas pa la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje klu brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/

de nas lha thams cad kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas/ gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wā ra kā ya wāktsitta/ inda/ dza ma/ dza la/ dzakkha/ bhū ta/ bahni/ bā u/ rakkha/ tsanda/ sudzdza/ mā da/ pappa tā la/ pa tā le/ aṭṭa sappa swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza dzi gha phulla dhū pa maṃ sa/ piṃ ga amba sappa kadzdza sā da khanti khu ṇi phe ṭa gā da/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ/ ā dya nuptanna twata oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis dbul/ arghaṃ pā dyaṃ/ badzra puṣpe la sogs pa phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ gau rī la sogs pa yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs la sogs pas bstod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po// rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med// rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che// mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// padma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung*// sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod nas phrin las gzhol ba ni/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor bcas dang*// klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// de la sogs pa 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag

/'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyis stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun grub shog /ces pas phrin las gzhol/ kolla i re ṭaṭhi a bo lā/ mummu ne re kakko lā/ gha ṇe kṛ bi ṭa ho bādzdza i/ kā ru ṇe ki a i na ro lā/ ta hiṃ ba la khādzdzā i/ ga ḍheṃ ma a ṇā pidzdzā i/ ha le ka liñdza ra pa ṇi a i/ dundur bādzdzi a i/ tsa u sa ma kasthu ri sihla/ kappu ra lā i a i/ mā la indā na sa liñdza/ ta hiṃ bha ru khā i a i/ phreṃ kha ṇa khe ṭa ka rante/ shuddha a shuddha na mu ni a i/ ni rāṃ su aṃ ge tsa ḍā wi/ ta hiṃ dza sa ra wa pa ṇi a i/ ma la a dze kunduru bā ṭa i/ ḍiṇḍi ma ta hinna pādzdzī a i/ zhes pas rdo rje'i glu blangs la byin dbab/ de nas phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brgyad pa'am/ yang na nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa// dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir stsol// zhes bkra shis brjod/ de nas yi ge brgya pas cho ga lhag chad kha bskang*/ smon lam gdab/ oṃ badzra muḥzhes brjod pas gtor ma'i mgron gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o// gtor ma'i cho ga'o// //de nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub blang*/

dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar badzra muḥzhes brjod la ye shes pa rnams gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o// phan yon gnyis te/ tshogs rdzogs shing ltung ba 'dag pa dang*/ lha rnams mnyes shing bar chad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ bza' btung gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa ltar ram/ yang na oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ rang he ru ka phyag gnyis par dran par bya/ de'i lag pa g.yas dgang gzar/ g.yon blugs gzar/ kha thab khung du bsam lte bar gtum mo'i me sbar nas lus thams cad gang*/ me'i nang du snying gar bla ma dang lha dgu/ lte bar chos skyong srung ma dang 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams bsams nas/ de dag mchod pa'i bsam pas ma chags par longs spyad/ lhag ma rnams lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la/ oṃ utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta bhakṣa sī swā hās byin/ ting nge 'dzin yin pas gsang sgrogs su mi 'gyur/ phan yon gnyis te/ yon yongs su dag pa dang*/ lha mchod par 'gyur ba'o/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor wal gyis dran par byas nas de'i dag pa dran par bya ste/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la// byams pa'i thugs la yan lag gnag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni// zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod// zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad// phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid// gug skyed kyis ni sangs rgyas lnga// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid// de nyid gsum ni spyan gsum mo// sha ni pukka sī ru brjod// de bzhin khrag ni ri khrod ma// gdol ba mo ni khu bar brjod// g.yung mo rkang dang tshil bu dag /pags pa byang chub yan lag bdun// rus pa bden pa bzhi po nyid// ces pa ni sku yi rnam dag go /phyag mtshan thod pa bcu drug ni/ byang chub kyi sems ā li'i rnam pa bcu drug dag pa yin la/

de dag na gnas pa'i phyag mtshan rnams ni/ glo dang dbugs dang de bzhin smyo// khong skem mdze dang birdzi ka /mchin pa mcher pa'i nad rnams la// glang po la sogs rim shes bya// zhes pa dang*/ sa ni dang po nor sbyin mtha'// dbang phyug brgyad ni stsol bar mdzad// ces pa'o// rgyan cha'i dag pa ni/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa// zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ ā li kā li lnga bcu dag pas mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i ngo shal lo// bzhugs tshul gyi dag pa ni/ srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis mnan pas rtsa ba'i zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gyis mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la bzhugs pas/ rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// yum ni gang zag dang chos kyi bdag gnyis kyis stong pa yin zhing*// de'i rgyan lnga ni/ thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lnga dag pa'o// phyag mtshan gyi dag pa ni/ nga rgyal la sogs skyon drug rnams// gcod phyir gri gug rnam par gnas// dngos dang dngos med rnam rtog gi /mgo bo padma'i snod du ni// bdud rnams rnam pa bzhi yi khrag /dngos grub phyir ni btung bar bya// zhes pa'o// stong pa dang snying rje kun du mnyam par sbyor ba'i phyir yab yum zhal sbyor gyi sku'o// 'khor gyi lha mo rnams kyi dag pa ni/ gzugs kyi phung po dag pa me long lta bu'i ye shes ni gaiau rī/ tshor ba dag pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes ni tsau rī/ 'du shes dag pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni be tā lī/ 'du byed dag pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ni ghasma rī/ rnam par shes pa dag pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes ni bcom ldan 'das/ sa'i khams dag pa byams pa tshad med pa ni pukka sī/ chu dag pa snying rje ni ri khrod ma/ me dag pa dga' ba ni gdol pa mo/ rlung dag pa btang snyoms ni g.yung mo'o snyam du dran par bya ba lha'i dag pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi rnam dag ni/

dkyil 'khor zhes ni gang bshad pa// yid nyid dkyil 'khor dam pa yin// gzhal med khang zhes bshad pa ni// sems ni gzhal med khang brtsegs 'phags// de yi phyi rol gru bzhi ni// mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// byams pa la sogs sems gang yin// thig skud bzhir ni yang dag bshad// thig gdab yang dag bshad pa ni// chos rjes dran pa'i sbyor ba'o// lta ba kun las rnam grol ba// ye shes thig tu bshad pa yin// rgyan rnams yang dag bshad pa ni// tshul khrims la sogs sdom pa mchog /dad dbang la sogs sems gang yin// rwa ba lngar ni yang dag byung*// rnam par thar pa bzhi po ni// sgo rnams su ni yang dag bshad// ka bar bcas pa'i rta babs bzhi// yang dag spong ba rnam pa bzhi// dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi po ni// kha khyer bzhir ni shes par bya// sgo khyud ces ni gang bshad pa// rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rnam pa bzhi// byang chub yan lag rnam bdun ni// phreng ba me tog chun 'phyang ldan// 'phags lam yan lag brgyad po ni// ka ba brgyad ces bya bar bshad// sgrib pa gnyis las rnam grol zhing*// ting 'dzin ye shes kyis brtags pa// lam gyi ye shes khyad par rnams// rnga yab ces ni yang dag bshad// nyon mongs thams cad 'joms pa'i phyir// do shal zhes ni rab tu bshad// nyon mongs phyir ni 'joms pa'i phyir// do shal phyed pa zhes bshad do// kun tu spyod pa'i khyad par gyis// nyon mongs 'phrog pas drwa ba nyid// tshogs gnyis kyi ni sbyor ba yis// 'khor lo bskor ba bla na med// ces pa rnams so// dur khrod ni lus rnam par dag pa yin la/ phyogs skyong zhing skyong la sogs pa dur khrod na gnas pa rnams ni/ 'khor ba'i chos rnams rnam par dag pa'o// srung ba'i 'khor lo ni bar du gcod pa'i chos rnams 'joms shing*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba rnam par dag pa'o// zhes dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa rnams ngag tu brjod cing sems kyis gsal bar dran par bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha mo brgyad rang la bsdu/

yum yab la bsdu/ yab kyang phyag gnyis par bsdus nas/ gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis bsrungs la/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma// rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma// sna la ser sna rdo rje ma// kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma// lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma// yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma// zhes dbang po'i dag pa dang*/ gzugs la dkar mor rtag tu bshad// sgra la chom rkun mar rab grags// dri yi cha la ro langs ma// ro la ghasma rīr rab grags// reg la sa spyod ma zhes brjod// chos kyi dbyings la mkha' spyod ma// zhes yul gyi dag pa dran par byas la/ dbang po rnams yul la 'jug pa'i tshe/ lha la lhas mchod pa'am/ lha dang lha snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba 'dod yon gyi bde bas lha mchod par bsam zhing*/ yul rnams la sdang zhen med par spyad do// thams cad du snang ba lha'i dkyil 'khor/ grag pa sngags/ rang gi lus lha/ ngag tu brjod pa sngags kyi bzlas pa/ sems kyi bsam pa ting nge 'dzin/ de thams cad kyang rnam pa sna tshogs su snang ba lha'i sku/ rang bzhin stong pa thugs kyi bdag nyid/ ngo bo zung du 'jug par shes par bya'o// de'i ngang las chos 'chad pa/ nyan pa/ klog pa/ mchod rten bzhengs pa/ chu sbyin/ dkyil 'khor gyi las/ rab gnas/ sbyin sreg la sogs pa rang dang gzhan gyi don du 'gyur ba rnams mngon par spyad de/ de dag so so'i cho ga ni gzhan du shes par bya'o// phan yon gnyis te gnas skabs kyi kun spyod thams cad lam du 'gyur ba dang*/ mthar thug rgyal ba'i phrin las mngon par 'grub pa'o// rjes su chags pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ yul dbang gis smin par byas pa la rung gi gzhan du na nyes par 'gyur ro// de'ang rang he ru ka dang rig ma bdag med mar bskyed pa lha yi 'du shes/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ gnyi ga'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyi byin gyis brlab pa sngags kyi 'du shes/

bde ba chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa mchod snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes dang ldan pas snyoms par zhugs te/ de las byung ba'i bde bas lus thams cad la khyab par bsgom zhing*/ ngo bo stong par bsams nas bde stong zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin bskyang*/ des de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor mchod par bsam/ kun nas chags pa'i bsam pa spang bar bya'o// phan yon gnyis te/ nyon mongs pas mi rdzi ba dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur ba'o// de dag gis ni mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor bstan te/ rnal 'byor pa'i nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi bya ba 'dis dus 'da' bar byas na/ ring por mi thogs par phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro// 'di dag nges par bya ba'i don du lung dang sbyar ba ni/ yi ge mangs par 'gyur bas 'dir ma bris la/ rgyas par shes par 'dod na kho bos sbyar ba'i mngon par rtogs pa lung dang sbyar ba las rtogs par bya'o// rgyal ba'i ye shes sgyu ma las byung ba'i// cho 'phrul gang gis gdul bya 'dul byed pa'i// rnam 'phrul de nyid rjes 'jug gang zag gi /lam yin 'bras bu'ang de ltar shes par gyis// lam gyi dngos gzhi mnyam par gzhag pa yis// sku gnyis thob byed rjes kyi yan lag brgyad// kun spyod kun nas dge ba'i lam gyur zhing*// lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las sgrub byed yin// bde ba'i lam nas bde bar gshegs gyur pa// bde mchog bde chen rdo rje 'chang dbang gis// bde chen la gzhol bde 'gro mchog rnams la// bde mchog bde blag sgrub pa'i lam 'di gsungs// ma lus shes bya'i snying po rgyal ba'i gsung*// gsung rab rgya mtsho'i snying po gsang ba'i tshul// tshul chen snying po yid bzhin nor bu'i gter// gter gyi snying po mchog 'dir bsdus pa yin// chos tshul 'di ni 'phags pa zhes bya la// bsod nams dbang phyug dpal 'byor lhun grub pa// blo gros rab gsal dad pa'i ngang tshul can// jim gyin zhes byas bskul nas sbyar ba yin// dge ba de yis ma lus 'gro ba yi// blo yi spyi gtsug mngon par rtogs pa yi// yid bzhin nor bu 'di yis rab brgyan nas// rgyal ba'i 'byor pa yid bzhin thob par shog

/dpal kye rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa'i tshul/ rje btsun bla ma rin po che byon zin pa de dag gis rab tu gsal bar mdzad du zin yang*/ nyung ngu'i don la blo gros spro ba gzhan mang pos kyang lan mang du bskul nas/ chos kyi rje mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa 'phags pas/ dpal kye rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes bya ba 'di/ sa pho rta'i lo dbyu gu'i zla ba la/ rgyal po go pe la'i pho brang chen por sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
